decision: Log out clears the forward-auth cookie, then sends the browser to DAAX_AUTH_LOGOUT_URL exactly as configured (on the fleet https://auth.<host>.poley.dev/logout, Pocket ID's sign-out confirmation page). The browser stays on the IdP and does not return to daax; with the variable unset, Log out signs out of daax only and reloads.
rationale: Every host runs its own Pocket ID, so the logout target is per-host runtime configuration served in GET /api/auth/user, not a build-time NEXT_PUBLIC value. The previous default, auth.poley.dev's /api/oidc/end-session, was baked into every published image. Pocket ID's /logout frontend route takes no redirect parameter and goes to the IdP's own '/' after signing out.
alternatives: OIDC RP-initiated logout at <idp>/api/oidc/end-session with post_logout_redirect_uri would return the browser to daax. Rejected for now: Pocket ID only honours the redirect when it can resolve a client (client_id or id_token_hint) whose logout callback URLs include it, and daax holds neither, because Traefik forward-auth owns the OIDC session. Without one it falls back to <AppURL>/logout, the same confirmation page. Revisit if daax becomes an OIDC client itself.
